entities.name: Basalt Spire
entities.description: Ancient tower in the Dead Zone of Ulgrotha that held the planeswalker Ravi.

entities.name: Ravi
entities.description: Planeswalker trapped in the Basalt Spire after unleashing the Apocalypse Chime.

events.summary: Ravi takes refuge in the spire from the devastation of the Apocalypse Chime.
events.quote: the planeswalker Ravi sought refuge within this dark and lonely spire

events.summary: Baron Sengir discovers and frees Ravi after countless generations.
events.quote: until she was eventually discovered and freed by Baron Sengir

events.summary: Time reduces the Spire to rubble, burying Ravi.
events.quote: reduced the Spire to rubble, burying Ravi beneath the remains

relations.note: He freed her from the tower.
relations.quote: until she was eventually discovered and freed by Baron Sengir
